title: Schedule of Charges on Auto Loans, with the State Annex
content:
The charges published for the Auto Loans line are set out below. The three charges named in the first table are published for the product; the three figures in the state annex are published for the borrower's state of residence.

## Charges published for the product

| Charge | Used Vehicle Loan | Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | Auto Refinance Loan | Lease Buyout Loan | New Vehicle Loan | Green Vehicle Loan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fee when a payment is returned unpaid, USD | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| Fee for each payment extension granted, USD | 35.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 |
| Courtesy late charge waivers per customer in a rolling 365 days | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 |
| Consecutive on-time installments a courtesy waiver requires | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |

## State annex

The three figures below are published for the borrower's state of residence and read the same on every product of the Auto Loans line.

| Borrower's state | Calendar days after the due date before a late charge applies | Late charge percentage published for the state | Late charge ceiling published for the state, USD |
|---|---|---|---|
| North Carolina | 15 | 4.0 | 25.00 |
| South Carolina | 10 | 5.0 | 18.50 |
| Virginia | 7 | 5.0 | 30.00 |

## Notes on the annex

The three states are the states in which Piedmont Crescent Bank holds Auto Loans borrowers of record. North Carolina is the most generous on time and the strictest on percentage; Virginia is the strictest on time and the most generous on ceiling.

## How the allowance and the flat charges read

The courtesy waiver row is counted per customer and not per loan, so a customer holding two Auto Loans draws on one allowance between them, except on the Green Vehicle Loan, whose published allowance is 2 in the same rolling window.

The two product charges in the first table are flat figures: the fee when a payment is returned unpaid stands at 25.00 USD and the fee for each payment extension at 35.00 USD whichever product the borrower holds and whichever state they live in.
